profileEvidence.summary: Quick, enthusiastic and closely attached to their people, Pyrenean Shepherds often stay wary of strangers. These resourceful mountain herders use their bodies to move livestock and can adapt their work as circumstances change. Rough-faced and smooth-faced forms share this working tradition; their small, agile forebears herded sheep while Great Pyrenees guarded the flocks.
profileEvidence.shortDescription: An alert, energetic mountain herder, often devoted to its people and wary of strangers, in rough- or smooth-faced form.
